Exercise 2.2 · Week 2

Polygon Party

Scratch (offline app) Work in pairs

Goal: draw shapes with the Pen using repeat and the rule turn = 360 ÷ sides. Tool: Scratch app (offline) with the Pen extension. Work in pairs.

Build steps

  1. Start a new project: File > New.
  2. Click the blue Add Extension button (bottom left corner) and choose Pen. A green Pen category appears.
  3. Make the cat small so you can see the lines: in the sprite pane set Size to 40.
  4. Build the square script below and click the green flag.
  5. Change the numbers to draw a triangle, then a hexagon, then a pentagon. Predict each shape before you click the flag.
  6. Bug hunt: Leo wanted a triangle and used repeat 3, move 100, turn 60. Predict what it draws, run it, then fix it.
  7. Save as polygon-party.

The script in words (square)

  • when green flag clicked
  • erase all
  • go to x: 0 y: 0
  • point in direction 90
  • pen down
  • repeat 4:
    • move 100 steps
    • turn right 90 degrees
  • pen up

Tip: put the green ( ) / ( ) block from Operators in the turn slot and type 360 and the number of sides. Scratch does the dividing for you.

Shape Sides Repeat Turn
Triangle 3 3 120
Square 4 ? ?
Pentagon 5 ? ?
Hexagon 6 ? ?

Expected behavior

Each time you click the flag, the old drawing is erased and the cat draws one closed shape (it ends exactly where it started). The square has 4 equal sides, the triangle 3, the pentagon 5 and the hexagon 6.

Checklist

Stuck? Open a hint

Try on your own first. Hints open one at a time, from a small nudge to a bigger one. None of them gives the answer away.

Hint 1: Where to look

Look at the table in the README. Find the pattern between the number of sides and the number of times you repeat. Then see how the turn changes as the shape gets more sides.

Hint 2: Try this

The rule is turn = 360 ÷ sides. A shape that closes turns all the way around, which is 360 degrees, by the end. Change the number in the repeat block, and change the turn to match.

Hint 3: Almost there

Put the ( ) / ( ) block from the Operators category into the turn slot, and type 360 in the first space. Leave the second space for the number of sides. For the triangle bug hunt, check whether the turn matches the rule for 3 sides.
